questions.question: What do smart machines mainly do before making a decision?
Which of the following is an example of pattern recognition?
options: Recognizing your face to unlock a phone
Using a ruler to measure length

questions.question: What is 'data' in Artificial Intelligence?
A smart machine learns that every time dark clouds appear, it usually rains. What has it learned?
Which of these is most likely used by an AI to predict tomorrow's weather?
If an AI is shown many pictures of cats and dogs, what is it trying to learn?
options: How to recognize the difference between cats and dogs

questions.question: Making a prediction means:
options: Looking into the future using magic
Using patterns from past data to guess what may happen next

questions.question: Which example shows AI making a prediction?
options: A music app suggesting your next favorite song

questions.question: Why does AI need lots of data?
options: To find better patterns and make smarter predictions

questions.question: Which of these is NOT an example of data?
A shopping website recommends toys based on what you bought before. This works because AI:
options: Finds patterns in your shopping history

questions.question: Which statement about smart machines is TRUE?
options: They always know the correct answer

questions.question: If an AI is trained using only pictures of apples, what may happen when it sees an orange?
options: It may get confused because it has not learned enough patterns
It will always know it is an orange

questions.question: Which type of information can AI learn from?
What helps AI improve its predictions over time?
options: Learning from more data and examples

questions.question: A teacher checks many old test scores to guess which students may need extra help. This is similar to AI because it:
Why can two smart machines give different predictions?
options: They may learn from different data

questions.question: Which situation BEST shows pattern recognition?
options: A phone recognizing your fingerprint every time you unlock it
A clock showing the current time
A book lying on a table

questions.question: What is the correct order of how AI usually works?
Which statement BEST describes how smart machines learn?
options: They memorize every answer without using data
They study data, discover patterns, and use those patterns to make predictions
They always ask humans before making every decision
They only work with numbers and cannot use pictures
